post.description:
Run the full AI analysis pipeline for a given resume against a target role.

Pipeline steps:
    1. Skill extraction
    2. Soft skill detection
    3. Gap analysis (matched / missing skills)
    4. Completeness check (sections present)
    5. Readiness score calculation
    6. Recommendation generation
    7. Persist AnalysisResult
    8. Update dashboard metrics
